walk.en: I stomp branch to branch, one weight per step.
My fists move first; my legs catch up.
Between the treetops I land heavily.
Snorting hard, I walk along the trunk.
Every step kicks the fallen leaves away.
I walk head down, but my ears are working.
I circle the tree looking for that one.
One flick of my tail snaps a branch.
I walk fast enough to burst through vines.
My soles grip and leave deep prints.
I grind my teeth as I go.
A sound ahead, so I speed up.

idle.en: I beat my chest and the sound carries far.
With nothing to do, I sharpen my claws.
I stare at a leaf, waiting for it to move.

idle.zh: 呼吸越来越重，火气上来了。
idle.en: My breathing deepens and my temper rises.
I have not forgotten that look you gave me.
I have gouged three holes in this tree.

idle.zh: 尾巴抽了一下，纯粹手痒。
idle.en: My tail lashes once, purely out of itch.
I sit down, then stand right back up.
Anyone will do; I want a fight.
I bite a branch in two.
The wind blows past and I grunt at it.
With nowhere to go, my anger keeps filling up.
I count my heartbeats; they are too fast.
Sitting still only makes me angrier.

look_player.en: You looked at me, so now I am angry.
Do not blink; that counts as a challenge too.
My eyes are red; did you notice.
You step back, and I burn hotter.
Eyes met, so the fight has started.

look_player.zh: 我呲牙，是给你留时间跑。
look_player.en: I bare my teeth to give you time to run.
What are you smiling at? I am not funny.
I raise my fist first, then strike.
Do not point that ball at me.
I shift one step forward as a warning.
Have you looked long enough yet.

look_player.zh: 我鼻孔喷气，你自己领会。
look_player.en: I snort through my nose; take the hint.
Turn around and I will chase you.

tempted.en: What is that smell? Something sweet.
That thing in your hand, toss it here.
Food buys me three seconds of calm.
I smell fruit; where is it.
I eat first, then hit you.
Give me half and I will not chase.
That thing is rustling; is it a bag.
I just reach out and snatch it.
I only came close because it smells good.

collide.en: You bumped into me; bad luck for you.
One shove of my shoulder and you stagger.
My fur is coarse; do not pet me.
One sweep of my tail knocks you aside.
A collision only stokes my temper.
Your foot is on my toes.

collide.zh: 别往我身上挤，我容易动手。
collide.en: Do not crowd me; my hands move fast.
I shove back; that is fair.
Both my fists are clenched now.

mate.en: I am bad at this, so do not laugh.
I beat my chest for you to see.
You come close and I actually go quiet.
This branch holds; sit with me.
I will catch something for you.
Do not stare too long; I will flush.
I will groom the fur on your back.
Fighting comes first, but you come second.
One smile from you and my anger is gone.

pickup.en: This stone, I could throw it.
I pick it up to see if it is edible.
Something shiny goes into my pocket.

pickup.zh: 树上掉的果子，我捡走了。
pickup.en: Fruit off the tree; I am taking it.
I squeeze it once and it crumbles.
A stick on the ground; handy.
I carry it in my teeth a while.
I pick it up and throw it away.
I keep it; it may be useful.

target_acquire.zh: 我来找你，就是你一个人。
target_acquire.en: I came for you, and only you.
I see you, so stand still.
I have waited a long time for this fight.
Stand still; let us talk with fists.
I growl low; that is the count of three.
The canopy is too small; we fight below.

target_acquire.zh: 打你这种事不需要理由。
target_acquire.en: Hitting you needs no excuse at all.
Come on, let us see who falls first.

targeting.en: I arch my back, ready to spring.
I slide to your flank; it is open.
Fist raised, I wait for you to move.
My breathing slows; that means I am serious.

targeting.zh: 你每次后退，我都跟一步。
targeting.en: Each time you retreat, I take a step.
First I cut off your retreat.
This punch is aimed at your jaw.
In my head I count to two.
Do not beg; I will not listen.

melee_attack.en: One punch down and the tree shakes.
That one landed on your shoulder.
I grab your arm and slam you down.
My tail whips your lower back.
My fist carries wind; you can hear it.
I leap and come down hard.
It landed, and my own hand aches.
I am panting, but I have not stopped.

spawn.en: I drop out of the canopy.
This tree is mine to stand on.
Leaves are still falling; I just landed.
The tree is tall, and I left claw marks.
I watch the ground from up here.
I just woke up in a foul mood.
This wood is too quiet for my taste.
I roar once so everyone knows.
The leaves crackle under my weight.
The sun cuts in, right in my eyes.
I grip the trunk and look down.

generic.en: That hurt, so I am angrier.

generic.zh: 这一下打偏了我的拳头。
generic.en: That blow knocked my fist off line.
I stagger back into the trunk.
My fur is full of grit.
I grit my teeth hard enough to hear them.
The wound is on my ribs; even breathing hurts.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
That blow did not draw blood.
I crouch, then push myself up.
You landed one, so just wait.

fire.en: My fur is singed and it stinks.

fall.en: I fell from the tree and my rear hurts.

drown.en: I should not have chased into the water.

explosion.en: After the blast my ears still buzz.

projectile.en: Something sharp is stuck in my shoulder.

magic.en: This wound was not made by a fist.

starvation.en: Hungry, my punches have no force.

lightning.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身毛直立。
lightning.en: Lightning struck and all my fur stands upright.

void.en: Falling into the dark, even the trees are gone.
